rows.name: Open
rows.note: opens for READ ONLY (FileAccess.Read) with FileShare.Read: it is the PIN on an owner original and the read handle on a view entry. It writes nothing, and while it is held no other process is granted write or delete on the file, so a run cannot be edited, replaced, renamed or deleted under it
